Mira Chen: pushed fixes for the backport tests + README steps; split the changelog into a separate commit. PTAL when you have a sec. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234
Adan Patel: thanks — will take a look in ~1h, heads up I may request a tiny test tweak if flaky
CI Bot: CI run queued for PR #1234 (commit a9f3b2c)
CI Bot: ✅ All checks passed — unit, integration, lint
Lydia Park: skimmed the diff. Nice cleanup. left one tiny inline suggestion about the table formatting in docs.md
Mira Chen: thanks @Lydia — addressed the table nit and force-pushed (a9f3b2d -> b0c4e1f). Also added a short note in README about the backport workflow
Adan Patel: looks much cleaner now. I left one comment about a log statement level (info -> debug) but that’s optional. overall LGTM
Mira Chen: changed that log to debug and squashed the fix into the docs commit. pushed b0c4e1f -> b1d5f77
Sam W: LGTM from me. Can we run a short canary in staging before merge?
Mira Chen: yes — canary job added to the PR checks, will trigger after approvals
Jen Liu: quick reminder to cherry-pick to release/1.3 after merge (we need this backport for the next patch). @Mira Chen can you handle the cherry-pick?
Mira Chen: yep, will cherry-pick once merged and open the release PR.
Deploy Bot: Canary deployment scheduled: staging -> canary-2026-03-17-15:00 UTC (PR #1234)
Sam W: pinging for a final approval — if canary is green I’ll merge in the next slot
Adan Patel: approving now. :thumbsup:
Lydia Park: approved as well. :white_check_mark:
CI Bot: Canary checks passed (smoke + perf lite)
Mira Chen: cherry-picked to release/1.3 as commit c3f9d44 and opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1235 (release backport)
Deploy Bot: Merge queued after canary window closes
Sam W: merged — thanks everyone for quick turnaround
Mira Chen: thanks! cc @support for the release note update :raised_hands:
Jen Liu: lovely. noting in the release board.
